input.summary: Cedar Prairie School District No. 427, RFP No. 27-02 District-Wide Custodial Services (1 yr + 4 one-year renewals from July 1, 2027). Registered all 19 rows of Exhibit A (17 school sites + 2 year-round support facilities) with Column (9) Permanent Building SF as gross and portable classrooms as added_areas (44 units / 42,944 SF; Pricing Area = Column 9 + portables per Sec. 2.3); gross is the cleaning basis (no deduction for kitchens, Sec. 2.8(a)/A6). Addendum No. 1 applied: Location 208 Old Mill Elementary deleted; Location 209 Riverbend portables revised 2 @ 960 -> 6 @ 960 (Column 9 unchanged 52,064); Location 901 Column (9) revised 18,240 -> 22,960 SF (adds Board Room/PD Annex 4,720 SF). Location 902 Transportation & Maintenance: 28,400 SF gross, ~6,850 SF cleanable (Note 6), M/W/F year-round. Schools M-F ~184 days + summer deep clean (strip/refinish, carpet extraction, gym wood floor screen-and-recoat); Glacier View (206) and Cedar Prairie HS (401) also summer school M-Th. Incumbent Sound & Summit Building Care, LLC (CPSD-C-22-031, awarded May 2022), $3,412,860 paid for 2025-26; $12,904,115 over 48 months. No grounds or dining scope: grounds maintenance and kitchens are excluded (Sec. 2.8); site acreage is information only, so no grounds areas were registered.

Exhibit B (Price Proposal Form, p. 8) was not registered as a separate table: its Pricing Area per location equals Exhibit A Column (9) plus portables (captured via added_areas), except Line 19 (902) which is the 6,850 SF cleanable area (recorded as cleanable_area).
